# Flow Commission

> > Flow Commission is a commission tracking and sales performance management platform designed to empower sales teams with transparent compensation, real-time analytics, and goal alignment.

Flow Commission integrates with Salesforce and other SaaS tools to help sales operations teams optimize incentive strategies, track customer acquisition costs, and motivate sales representatives through transparent commission management and performance metrics.

## Key Topics

- Commission tracking and management
- Sales team motivation and empowerment
- Transparent compensation structures
- Sales operations optimization
- Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
- Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
- Sales analytics and reporting
- Performance incentive strategies
- Sales goals alignment
- Salesforce integration
- Real-time commission visibility
- Sales metrics and dashboards
- Team performance management
- SaaS sales operations
- Commission automation

## Core Platform Features

- [Empower Your Sales Team](https://flowcommission.com/sales-team/): Sales team empowerment with Flow Commission tracking and motivation tools
- [Sales Operations & Control](https://flowcommission.com/operations/): Sales operations optimization with real-time tracking and analytics

## Sales Metrics Glossary

- [Key Performance Indicators](https://flowcommission.com/glossary/key-performance-indicators/): KPI definition covering sales metrics and performance measurement
- [Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)](https://flowcommission.com/glossary/customer-acquisition-cost-cac/): CAC metric definition for sales and marketing efficiency tracking
